segments.an8.81:1.1: “Satisampajaññe, bhikkhave, asati satisampajaññavipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti hirottappaṃ.
segments.an8.81:1.2: Hirottappe asati hirottappavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti indriyasaṃvaro.
segments.an8.81:1.3: Indriyasaṃvare asati indriyasaṃvaravipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti sīlaṃ.
segments.an8.81:1.4: Sīle asati sīlavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti sammāsamādhi.
segments.an8.81:1.5: Sammāsamādhimhi asati sammāsamādhivipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an8.81:1.6: Yathābhūtañāṇadassane asati yathābhūtañāṇadassanavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti nibbidāvirāgo.
segments.an8.81:1.7: Nibbidāvirāge asati nibbidāvirāgavipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an8.81:1.8: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rukkho sākhāpalāsavipanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi na pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi … pheggupi … sāropi na pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an8.81:1.9: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, satisampajaññe asati satisampajaññavipannassa hatūpanisaṃ hoti hirottappaṃ;
segments.an8.81:1.10: hirottappe asati hirottappavipannassa hatūpaniso hoti … pe …
segments.an8.81:2.1: “Satisampajaññe, bhikkhave, sati satisampajaññasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti hirottappaṃ.
segments.an8.81:2.2: Hirottappe sati hirottappasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti indriyasaṃvaro.
segments.an8.81:2.3: Indriyasaṃvare sati indriyasaṃvarasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti sīlaṃ.
segments.an8.81:2.4: Sīle sati sīlasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti sammāsamādhi.
segments.an8.81:2.5: Sammāsamādhimhi sati sammāsamādhisampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an8.81:2.6: Yathābhūtañāṇadassane sati yathābhūtañāṇadassanasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti nibbidāvirāgo.
segments.an8.81:2.7: Nibbidāvirāge sati nibbidāvirāgasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ.
segments.an8.81:2.8: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rukkho sākhāpalāsasampanno. Tassa papaṭikāpi pāripūriṃ gacchati, tacopi … pheggupi … sāropi pāripūriṃ gacchati.
segments.an8.81:2.9: Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, satisampajaññe sati satisampajaññasampannassa upanisasampannaṃ hoti hirottappaṃ;
segments.an8.81:2.10: hirottappe sati hirottappasampannassa upanisasampanno hoti … pe …

lines: No ca paripucchitāti atthānatthaṃ kāraṇākāraṇaṃ paripucchitā na hoti.
Ekantapaṭibhānā tathāgataṃ dhammadesanā hotīti tathāgatassa ekantapaṭibhānā dhammadesanā hoti, ekanteneva paṭibhāti upaṭṭhātīti attho.
